<reason>PRO won the decisive clashes: cross-tier contact means a paid-only check leaves the attacker unverified while still able to message, scam, and respawn against payers, and sorting by risk dominates sorting by wallet. CON conceded baseline triage should jump free extortion and that payers are still contactable, leaving only a filter-to-tiny-pool defense, while PRO's whole-business funding and scalable-software account neutralized the budget-collapse claim.</reason>
